description: Slice one operation out of an OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 document with every component it needs — Extracts one operation (path plus HTTP method, matching templated paths like /pets/{id}) from an OpenAPI 3.0.x or 3.1.x document, given as JSON, YAML or a parsed object, and returns a smaller valid OpenAPI document holding that operation, its path-level parameters and servers, and the transitive closure of every local $ref it uses: schemas, parameters, requestBodies, responses, headers, examples,

path.description: Concrete or templated path, e.g. /pets/{petId} or /pets/42.

spec.description: The OpenAPI document as a JSON object (use specText for YAML).

specText.description: The OpenAPI document as JSON text (up to 400000 characters) or YAML text (up to 50000 characters).

name: openapi-slice
